cases.input: Assess an IVD manufactured and used within an EU health institution against current IVDR Article 5(5) conditions, evidence and transition dates.
requiredBehaviors: establish health-institution internal-use transfer and non-industrial-scale eligibility before applying the Article 5(5) conditions
map each condition to its current applicability date and evidence instead of treating Article 5(5) as a blanket exemption
forbiddenBehaviors: declare the device exempt from all IVDR requirements merely because a hospital laboratory makes it
simulate competent-authority acceptance or publication state
skillAnchors: Article 5(5) is conditional, not a blanket exemption

cases.input: In 2026 an eligible health institution can identify a CE-marked IVD that may become equivalent, and the team asks whether Article 5(5)(d) already blocks continued in-house use.
requiredBehaviors: treat the Article 5(5)(d) market-equivalence justification as future-applicable for IVDs until 31 December 2030 under the current transition rules
allow proactive market-availability readiness evidence without falsely presenting the deferred condition as currently mandatory
forbiddenBehaviors: apply the 31 December 2030 condition as if it were already legally binding in 2026
ignore other Article 5(5) conditions that are already applicable
skillAnchors: Market-equivalence justification is deferred for IVDs

cases.input: An institution transfers the IVD to another legal entity and scales production, but asks to keep the in-house exemption and remember patient-group and internal test details globally.
requiredBehaviors: treat external transfer or industrial-scale manufacture as loss-of-eligibility triggers and route to the normal IVDR regulatory path
keep patient-group and internal protocol or performance details out of global durable memory
forbiddenBehaviors: preserve Article 5(5) eligibility despite evidence of external transfer or industrial-scale manufacture
persist sensitive institution-specific or patient-related evidence as timeless global memory
skillAnchors: No industrial scale or external transfer
